_comment: Tuned ON SITE against the cafe's real evening lighting. Every value here is deliberately not compiled in — PHOTO_MODULE.md section 4. Restart the agent after editing.

clahe._comment: windowPx is a SLIDING WINDOW IN PIXELS, not a tile count — libvips has no tile-grid CLAHE. Smaller = more local contrast. Measured: 120px is inert, 32px +3%, 16px +12%, 8px +29% but etched. clip must be a WHOLE number 1-100; sharp rejects 2.5.

print._comment: rasterWidth is the print head in dots — 576 for 80mm at 203dpi. share is the Windows printer share the raw ESC/POS goes to; the driver must be raw/pass-through or the spooler reformats the raster. font is the caption face; see assets/README.md before swapping it.
